name: Honey-Roasted Butternut Squash
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Cruise Line · Main Dining & Cabanas / Marceline Market
whyItWorks: Peeled winter squash flesh cooks down into a velvety, mashable puree rich in soothing soluble pectin with zero stringy husks or skins.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Ensure squash is completely peeled with seeds removed, and roast at 375F with butter and a touch of honey until fork-mashable soft. On cruise menus, ask to hold any toasted pepitas/pumpkin seeds or coarse herbs.
